boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain St. John Fisher University
boards.description: Ten currently documented late-night Rochester destinations, including two on-campus options, for food or a productive reset after evening commitments.

cards.title: Lavery Library
cards.subtitle: St. John Fisher University campus
cards.notes: Bring your Fisher ID for late building access, then settle into a library work session before the documented midnight closing time.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus study destination with midnight hours on several regular-service days.
cards.evidence_claim: Lavery Library lists regular building hours until midnight Monday through Thursday and Sunday; swipe-card access is required after 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Library Hours | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: Regular building hours are 7:30 a.m.–midnight Monday–Thursday and 8:30 a.m.–midnight Sunday. A swipe card is required after 10 p.m.; seasonal exceptions are listed by the library.

cards.title: Lavery Library 24/7 Study Hall
cards.subtitle: Walkway between Lavery Library and the Campus Center
cards.notes: Use the study hall in the library–Campus Center walkway when a late assignment needs a focused on-campus setting beyond building hours.
cards.short_summary: A separately identified on-campus study space available around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John Fisher University states that a 24/7 Study Hall is available in the walkway connecting Lavery Library and the Campus Center.
cards.source_title: Library Hours | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: The University identifies this as a 24/7 Study Hall; follow campus access policies and use the listed location in the library–Campus Center walkway.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Jefferson Road
cards.subtitle: 566 Jefferson Rd, Rochester
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s current location page before leaving, then use the listed restaurant or drive-thru service for a late food stop.
cards.short_summary: A Rochester restaurant with documented daily service to 3 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists both restaurant and drive-thru hours of 10 a.m.–3 a.m. daily for its 566 Jefferson Road location.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant and drive-thru service daily until 3 a.m.; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Wendy’s on East Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1844 East Avenue, Rochester
cards.notes: Confirm the location page on the day, then choose restaurant or drive-thru service for a documented late-hour meal option.
cards.short_summary: An East Avenue restaurant and drive-thru listed until 2 a.m. every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 10 a.m.–2 a.m. daily at 1844 East Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant and drive-thru service daily until 2 a.m.; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Jefferson Road
cards.subtitle: 950 Jefferson Rd, Rochester
cards.notes: Use the official store page to confirm service before departure; its drive-thru is the documented option after the dining room closes.
cards.short_summary: A Jefferson Road option with drive-thru hours extending to 3 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours of 7 a.m.–3 a.m. daily for 950 Jefferson Road; its dine-in hours end earlier.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until 3 a.m. daily. The official page lists earlier dine-in hours, so do not assume indoor service is available late.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Lehigh Station Road
cards.subtitle: 1008 Lehigh Station Rd, Rochester
cards.notes: Plan around the official drive-thru schedule, particularly if you need a later Friday or Saturday food option after an evening commitment.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Rochester-area location with later weekend drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 1008 Lehigh Station Road.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 1008 Lehigh Station Road, Rochester
cards.access_notes: The official page lists drive-thru service until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Denny’s on West Ridge Road
cards.subtitle: 2890 W. Ridge Rd, Rochester
cards.notes: For an any-hour meal option, verify the official location page and use its listed restaurant service rather than relying on third-party hours.
cards.short_summary: A Rochester diner whose official location page lists 24-hour operation.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s lists its 2890 W. Ridge Road Rochester restaurant as open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists the restaurant as open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Dunkin’ on East Ridge Road
cards.subtitle: 1220 E Ridge Rd, Rochester
cards.notes: Use the official location listing for an around-the-clock coffee, donut, bagel, or sandwich stop when conventional dining hours have ended.
cards.short_summary: A Dunkin’ location with 24-hour operation listed for every day of the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Dunkin’ lists the 1220 E Ridge Road location as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 24-hour hours every day and identifies drive-thru and mobile-ordering features.

cards.title: Jack’s BBQ & Pizza
cards.subtitle: 3055 Buffalo Rd, Rochester
cards.notes: Reserve this for a Friday, Saturday, or Sunday evening and check the business page before heading out for its listed late carryout or delivery window.
cards.short_summary: A casual Rochester pizza and barbecue restaurant with documented weekend late hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack’s BBQ & Pizza lists hours until 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday and until midnight Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Business page lists Friday–Saturday hours of 4 p.m.–2 a.m. and Sunday hours of 4 p.m.–midnight; Tuesday–Thursday close at 11 p.m.

cards.title: The Winfield Grill
cards.subtitle: 647 N. Winton Rd, Rochester
cards.notes: Check the official hours before making the trip, then use the documented dine-in or takeout option on the nights the kitchen is open late.
cards.short_summary: A Rochester restaurant with midnight weekday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Winfield Grill lists dine-in and takeout hours until midnight Monday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: The Winfield Grill — Contact and Hours
cards.access_notes: Official page lists dine-in and takeout until midnight Monday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday; Sunday closes at 8 p.m.
